description: This Java class, 'SimpleContentViewHandler', is a custom web view handler within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages rendering content resources, handling security checks, and preparing the response for content delivery through HTTP responses. Its main functions include initializing the handler, preparing the view context, retrieving content data, checking permissions, and streaming the content to the browser.

classes.name: SimpleContentViewHandler
classes.description: A web view handler for rendering content resources, with methods to initialize context, prepare content rendering, and stream content to HTTP response within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with servlet context parameters, setting root directory and HTTPS configuration.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares the context map for view rendering, extracting parameters from the request and sanitizing if in a secure context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method that performs content retrieval, permission checks, and streams the content byte stream to the HTTP response, handling various content types and security constraints.
